routines.note: The owner is unreachable Friday and Saturday. Nothing is scheduled to land then.

required.GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON: Search Console Search Analytics, URL Inspection, Indexing API. Free. Create a service account in Google Cloud and add its client_email as a user on the GSC property.
required.GOOGLE_API_KEY: PageSpeed Insights v5 and CrUX field data. Free, 25k requests/day.
required.BING_WEBMASTER_API_KEY: Bing Webmaster Tools. Free. Settings > API access. Without it IndexNow submissions are accepted but unreadable.

deliberatelyAbsent.GA4: The CSP blocks third-party connections and assets/notice.js promises visitors there are no analytics. Measurement comes from Search Console instead.
deliberatelyAbsent.DATAFORSEO: Paid. Not connected. seo-dataforseo stays idle until it is.
